review_notes: I read the whole file. It has four instances: DistribSMul and IsScalarTower ℚ≥0 R R and ℚ R R, for division semirings and rings. I grepped Mathlib for other DistribSMul or IsScalarTower instances on ℚ or ℚ≥0. The only other hits were hypotheses and the Module/Rat.lean tower lemmas, which need Module assumptions and do not cover this case. The SMul ℚ≥0 K instance in Field/Defs.lean is the underlying structure that these instances build on, so it is not a competitor. I found no competing definition of a concept already in Mathlib. The ℚ and ℚ≥0 versions are parallel instances for different scalar types, not duplicate concepts.
